anomalies.observed: The LD39200PU33R LDO (REG2) has its output pin 1 (OUT) and ground pin 3 (GND) on the same net named '+3.3V'.
anomalies.expected: REG2 pin 1 (OUT) should be connected to the 3.3V rail (e.g., net '+3V3'), separate from pin 3 (GND) which should be on ground.

evidence.quote: 3.3 V LDO (MCUs + sensors) | Hades (top sheet) | ST LD39200PU33R ... produces 3V3 for "MCUs and Sensors"

anomalies.impact: The 3.3V regulator output is shorted to ground, preventing the 3.3V rail from being generated and likely causing the LDO to enter current limit or shut down.

anomalies.observed: All VDD power pins of the STM32H753VITx (FCC1) and STM32F405RGTx (NAVC1) are on unconnected nets.
anomalies.expected: These VDD pins should be connected to the 3.3V rail (net '+3V3') to power the MCUs.

evidence.quote: 3V3 feeds both MCUs (FCC, NAVC) and all I2C sensor ICs

anomalies.impact: Both microcontrollers are completely unpowered, so the board cannot function.

anomalies.observed: The netlist contains no CH330 USB-UART bridge components, despite the specification listing two of them.
anomalies.expected: Two otter_CH330 USB-UART bridge ICs should be present in the Connections sheet.
anomalies.impact: The USB-to-UART programming/debug interface is missing, so the board cannot be programmed or debugged via USB-UART.
